title: Boiled Algerian Chicken
description: A hearty and flavorful Algerian chicken dish made with tender boiled chicken, served with a side of steamed vegetables and a light salad.

ingredients.name: algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

instructions: Fill a large bowl with cold water and add 1 tablespoon of salt. Submerge the chicken leg and let it soak for 30 minutes.
Preheat a large pot of water over high heat and bring it to a boil.
Remove the chicken from the brine and place it in the boiling water.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the water and place it on a plate to rest.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped onion, minced garlic, olive oil, salt, pepper, and Algerian spice blend.
Stir to combine and let it sit for 5 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Add the lemon juice to the bowl and stir to combine.
Slice the rested chicken and serve it with the onion and garlic mixture spooned over the top.
